scope: Code correctness and bounded-memory execution; not the real v5 denominator, device fit, or model quality.

definition.source: Frozen documents.jsonl text; kept train rows; requested labels only
definition.encoding: Selected tokenizer vocabulary and normalizer; padding and truncation disabled in memory; add_special_tokens=False
definition.authentication: Raw binary-line SHA-256 through EOF, including blank-line bytes
definition.storage: SQLite file-backed deduplication, 8192 KiB cache; bounded text batches

verification.command: uv run --locked --extra cpu pytest -q tests/test_corpus_token_denominator.py tests/test_corpus_token_identity.py tests/test_campaign.py tests/test_campaign_policy.py tests/test_streaming_packing.py tests/test_corpus_exports.py

uv run --locked --extra cpu pytest -q tests/test_corpus_*.py tests/test_tokenizer*.py tests/test_worker*.py tests/test_experiment*.py -m 'not mps and not mlx and not cuda and not rocm and not xpu and not network'
uv run --locked --extra cpu pytest -q tests/test_preparation_options.py tests/test_streaming_packing.py
uv run --locked --extra cpu pytest -q -n 2 --dist loadfile -m 'not mps and not mlx and not cuda and not rocm and not xpu and not network'

bounded_subprocess.encoding: Real WordLevel tokenizer; distinct valid content hashes; raw source count equals all rows
bounded_subprocess.isolation: Fresh lightweight interpreter launches the measured interpreter; Linux ru_maxrss otherwise retains the test runner's pre-exec RSS peak

independent_refusals: dangling symlink shadowing a release reference

failure_boundary_proof.directory_fsync_failure: Before: COMPLETE final remained; after: no final and INTERRUPTED marker
failure_boundary_proof.completion_progress_failure: Regression confirms no COMPLETE final and retained INTERRUPTED marker
failure_boundary_proof.post_link_keyboard_interrupt: Before: COMPLETE final remained; after: own publication removed and INTERRUPTED marker retained
failure_boundary_proof.competing_publisher: Existing other-publisher bytes preserved after exclusive-link conflict
failure_boundary_proof.saved_padding_and_truncation: Authenticated fixture counted 640 before versus correct 415 after; artifact bytes and saved settings unchanged

local_readiness.command: uv run --locked --extra cpu sparselab --work-dir /srv/sparselab/state readiness smoke --family dense --output /srv/sparselab/state/experiments/devmind-pretrain-v5/scratch/implementation-readiness-dense-raw
local_readiness.scope: Dense CPU CLI inspect/preflight/prepare/stage/train/checkpoint/eval/generate/child resume on tiny synthetic data
